name.label: Name
name.info: Name of the thermostat and of its climate entity.

temperature_sensor_entity_id.label: Room temperature sensor
temperature_sensor_entity_id.hint: Where people sit, away from windows and the heater.
temperature_sensor_entity_id.info: The temperature VT regulates on. Place it in the middle of the living space: next to a window it reacts to drafts, next to the heater it reads too warm and the room stays cold.

humidity_sensor_entity_id.label: Humidity sensor
humidity_sensor_entity_id.hint: Optional. Shown on the thermostat, not used for heating.
humidity_sensor_entity_id.info: Exposes humidity on the thermostat card; it does not change regulation. When the room sensor's device also measures humidity, the panel pre-fills that sensor (VT's flow did this silently as 'enabled but empty').

last_seen_temperature_sensor_entity_id.label: Sensor 'last seen' time
last_seen_temperature_sensor_entity_id.hint: Optional. Prevents false alarms from sensors that only report changes.
last_seen_temperature_sensor_entity_id.info: A datetime entity telling when the temperature sensor last checked in (many Zigbee sensors have 'last_seen'). Battery sensors stay silent while the temperature is stable; without this, VT may think the sensor died and switch to sensor-loss mode.

external_temperature_sensor_entity_id.label: Outdoor temperature sensor
external_temperature_sensor_entity_id.hint: Used to heat more when it is cold outside.
external_temperature_sensor_entity_id.info: Feeds the outdoor part of the heating calculation (coef_ext). If it stops reporting, sensor-loss mode can trigger too, unless disabled globally in configuration.yaml.

temp_min.label: Lowest settable temperature
temp_min.info: The thermostat will not accept a target below this. Default 7 °C.

temp_max.label: Highest settable temperature
temp_max.info: The thermostat will not accept a target above this. Default 35 °C.

step_temperature.label: Temperature step
step_temperature.info: How much one +/− press changes the target. Default 0.1 °C.

underlying_entity_ids.label: Devices to control
underlying_entity_ids.info:
**over_switch**: switch, input_boolean, select or climate entities.
**over_valve**: number entities that set the valve opening.
**over_climate**: climate entities.

ac_mode.label: Air conditioning
ac_mode.info: over_switch / over_valve: only cooling is offered. over_climate: heating and cooling, if the device supports both. Adds cooling (clim) presets.

inverse_switch_command.label: Inverted switch
inverse_switch_command.hint: For pilot-wire modules with a diode.
inverse_switch_command.info: On means heater off and off means heater on. Needed for some French pilot-wire setups (fil pilote) with a diode.

heater_keep_alive.label: Keep-alive interval (s)
heater_keep_alive.hint: Resend the current state regularly. Empty: off.
heater_keep_alive.info: Some devices switch themselves off if they hear nothing for a while. VT then repeats the current on/off command at this interval.

on_command_text.label: Custom on/off commands
on_command_text.hint: Needed when a device is not a plain switch.
on_command_text.info: Format command[/attribute[:value]], one per device, in the same order as the devices. Examples: select_option/option:comfort, set_hvac_mode/hvac_mode:heat. Plain switches use turn_on / turn_off automatically.

used_by_controls_central_boiler.label: Heated by the central boiler
used_by_controls_central_boiler.hint: Turns the boiler on when this room needs heat.
used_by_controls_central_boiler.info: Counts this thermostat's devices for the central boiler (configured in the central configuration). Rooms on electric heaters usually stay off.

auto_fan_mode.label: Boost fan when far from target
auto_fan_mode.info: Runs the device's fan at this level while the room is far from the target, so heat spreads faster. Falls back to the quietest mode once close.

auto_regulation_dtemp.label: Smallest change sent (°)
auto_regulation_dtemp.hint: Smaller target changes are not sent.
auto_regulation_dtemp.info: Avoids sending a new target for every tiny change; some devices beep or drain batteries on each command. Too high and the correction stops working.

auto_regulation_periode_min.label: Minimum time between changes (min)
auto_regulation_periode_min.info: A new target is sent at most this often.

opening_threshold_degree.label: Treat as closed below (%)
opening_threshold_degree.hint: Requested openings below this close the valve.
opening_threshold_degree.info: Requested opening below this value counts as 'no heat': the valve goes to its most closed position and the room counts as not heating (also for the central boiler).

min_opening_degrees.label: Minimum opening when heating (%)
min_opening_degrees.hint: One value per valve, comma separated.
min_opening_degrees.info: As soon as the room needs heat the valve opens at least this far. Use it for valves with a dead zone where the first % let no water through. Example: 15 or '15, 20'.

max_opening_degrees.label: Maximum opening (%)
max_opening_degrees.hint: One value per valve, comma separated.
max_opening_degrees.info: The valve never opens further. Limits flow, e.g. to balance radiators. Must be above the minimum opening.

max_closing_degree.label: How far the valve may close (%)
max_closing_degree.info: Set below 100 to always leave a little water flowing, e.g. 90 keeps 10 % open (quieter, protects the pump).

auto_regulation_mode.label: Correction strength
auto_regulation_mode.hint: Start with Light, raise only if the room misses the target.
auto_regulation_mode.info: The device regulates on its own sensor, which often sits next to the heat. VT shifts the target it sends so the room sensor reaches your temperature. Light: up to 1.5 °, Medium: 2 °, Strong: 3 °. Expert uses values from configuration.yaml. 'Direct valve control' instead sets the valve opening itself (needs an opening entity). More correction means more energy and wear.

auto_regulation_use_device_temp.label: Compensate the device's own sensor
auto_regulation_use_device_temp.info: Adds (device temperature − room temperature) to the target. Example: room 18 °, device reads 22 °: VT sends 4 ° more so the device actually heats. Unstable device sensors make this worse.

opening_degree_entity_ids.label: Valve opening entities
opening_degree_entity_ids.hint: One per device, same order as the devices.
opening_degree_entity_ids.info: The number entities that set each valve's opening.

closing_degree_entity_ids.label: Valve closing entities
closing_degree_entity_ids.info: If the valve also has a closing entity, VT sets it to 100 − opening.

sync_entity_ids.label: Entities to sync
sync_entity_ids.hint: One per device, same order as the devices.
sync_entity_ids.info: Either the device's temperature calibration entity (offset mode) or its external temperature input (direct mode). Some devices need an extra setting, e.g. Sonoff TRVZB: sensor_select = external.

sync_with_calibration.label: Use calibration offset
sync_with_calibration.hint: On: adjust the device's offset. Off: send the room temperature.
sync_with_calibration.info: Offset mode works with most TRVs (local_temperature_calibration). Direct mode needs a device that accepts an external temperature.

proportional_function.label: Algorithm
proportional_function.hint: TPI is built in; plugins such as SmartPI add others.
proportional_function.info: SmartPI learns the room and is recommended by VT's author.

cycle_min.label: Cycle length (min)
cycle_min.hint: 5 minutes suits most rooms; longer for slow heating.
cycle_min.info: VT recalculates once per cycle and, for switches, turns the heater on for part of it. Slow systems (underfloor, storage heaters) want longer cycles; too short and the heater never warms up.

tpi_coef_int.label: Room gap factor (coef_int)
tpi_coef_int.hint: Higher: catches up faster. Lower if it overshoots.
tpi_coef_int.info: Heating share = coef_int × (target − room) + coef_ext × (target − outdoor). Reaching the target too slowly: raise it. Oscillating around the target: lower it. Default 0.6.

tpi_coef_ext.label: Outdoor factor (coef_ext)
tpi_coef_ext.hint: Raise if the room settles below target.
tpi_coef_ext.info: Compensates heat lost to the outside. Settles below the target: raise it. Settles above: lower it. Default 0.01.

minimal_activation_delay.label: Shortest on-time (s)
minimal_activation_delay.info: Avoids pulses too short for the heater to do anything. Default 10 s.

minimal_deactivation_delay.label: Shortest off-time (s)
minimal_deactivation_delay.info: Avoids flicking off for a few seconds. Default 0.

tpi_threshold_high.label: Stop heating above target + (°)
tpi_threshold_high.hint: 0 = off. Needs the resume value too.
tpi_threshold_high.info: If the room gets this much warmer than the target, heating stops completely until it falls below target + resume value. Both values must be set.

tpi_threshold_low.label: Resume below target + (°)
tpi_threshold_low.hint: Must be smaller than the stop value.

auto_tpi_learning_type.label: Learning type
auto_tpi_learning_type.hint: Discovery for a new setup, Fine tuning to refine.
auto_tpi_learning_type.info: Learning sessions take about 48 h and are started manually (service or Auto-TPI card). Discovery: fast, from scratch. Fine tuning: slow, small corrections.

auto_tpi_heating_rate.label: Heating rate (°/h)
auto_tpi_heating_rate.info: How fast the heater can warm the room at full power.

heater_heating_time.label: Warm-up time (min)
heater_heating_time.hint: Time to reach full power, e.g. 5 for an electric radiator.

heater_cooling_time.label: Cool-down time (min)
heater_cooling_time.hint: Time to cool after stopping, e.g. 7 for an electric radiator.

auto_tpi_aggressiveness.label: Aggressiveness
auto_tpi_aggressiveness.info: Scales the learned coefficients down. 1.0 = use them as learned.

auto_tpi_ema_alpha.label: Alpha
auto_tpi_ema_alpha.hint: Higher reacts faster to recent cycles.

auto_tpi_continuous_kext_alpha.label: Background learning speed
auto_tpi_continuous_kext_alpha.hint: Default 0.04 ≈ a few days to adapt.

use_presets_central_config.label: Use the central preset temperatures
use_presets_central_config.hint: Off: this room has its own Eco/Comfort/Boost temperatures.
use_presets_central_config.info: Preset temperatures are number entities on the thermostat, or on the central configuration when this is on.

use_central_mode.label: Follow the central mode switch
use_central_mode.hint: Lets one switch stop all rooms or set them to frost protection.
use_central_mode.info: The central configuration has a select (Auto, Stopped, Heat only, Cool only, Frost protection) that controls every thermostat with this on.

window_sensor_entity_id.label: Window sensor
window_sensor_entity_id.hint: A binary sensor or a group of them.
window_sensor_entity_id.info: For several windows, make a binary_sensor group.

window_delay.label: Wait before reacting (s)
window_delay.hint: Short airing does not stop the heating.
window_delay.info: The window must stay open this long before the action happens.

window_off_delay.label: Wait after closing (s)
window_off_delay.info: The window must stay closed this long before heating resumes.

window_auto_open_threshold.label: Detect when falling faster than (°/h)
window_auto_open_threshold.hint: Lower detects sooner, with more false alarms. Try 3.
window_auto_open_threshold.info: VT watches the temperature slope. A sudden drop beyond this rate counts as an open window. Not for hallways or rooms with normal big swings.

window_auto_max_duration.label: Give up after (min)
window_auto_max_duration.hint: Heating resumes even if it keeps cooling. Try 30–60.

window_action.label: When open
window_action.hint: Turn off, fan only, frost protection or eco.
window_action.info: Frost protection and Eco change the target without changing the preset, so the preset shown can differ from the target.

motion_sensor_entity_id.label: Motion sensor
motion_sensor_entity_id.info: Room level. The thermostat follows it only in the 'Activity' preset.

presence_sensor_entity_id.label: Home occupancy sensor
presence_sensor_entity_id.info: A person entity, or a binary sensor (a binary_sensor group works). A group of persons does not: VT's docs (French original too) recommend a template sensor for that. While away, the 'away' preset temperatures (separate entities) apply.

device_power.label: Device power
device_power.hint: Total of all devices; same unit everywhere.
device_power.info: Used for the energy sensors, load shedding and the central boiler.

power_sensor_entity_id.label: Home consumption sensor
power_sensor_entity_id.hint: Total power the home uses right now.

max_power_sensor_entity_id.label: Maximum allowed power sensor
max_power_sensor_entity_id.hint: Keep a margin below your main fuse.
max_power_sensor_entity_id.info: Not a safety feature: overload is still possible between sensor updates.

safety_delay_min.label: Sensor silent for (min)
safety_delay_min.hint: Then switch to a safe fixed power. Battery sensors: 120–240.
safety_delay_min.info: If no temperature arrives for this long, VT stops trusting the sensor. Set 'last seen' in Room to avoid false alarms.

safety_min_on_percent.label: Only when heating at least
safety_min_on_percent.hint: 0.5 = 50 %. Below this, sensor loss is ignored.
safety_min_on_percent.info: A heater running low cannot overheat the room, so no need to react.

manual_override_duration_min.label: Return to preset after a manual change (min)

repair_incorrect_state.label: Resend ignored commands
repair_incorrect_state.hint: For relays or valves that sometimes miss a command.
repair_incorrect_state.info: Max 5 retries in a row; frequent repairs point to a hardware or network problem.

heating_failure_detection_delay.label: Alert after (min)
heating_failure_detection_delay.hint: Raise for underfloor heating or large rooms.

auto_start_stop_level.label: Reaction speed
auto_start_stop_level.hint: Fast stops and restarts more often.
auto_start_stop_level.info: Very slow ≈ 60 min between stop and restart, slow ≈ 30, medium ≈ 15, fast ≈ 7. Only restarts devices it stopped itself.

lock_users.label: Block changes from the UI
lock_users.info: Window actions, safety and load shedding keep working while locked.

auto_regulation_dtemp@thermostat_over_va.label: Smallest opening change sent (%)
auto_regulation_dtemp@thermostat_over_va.hint: Smaller changes are not sent to the valve.
auto_regulation_dtemp@thermostat_over_va.info: Limits how often the valve moves (noise, battery).

auto_regulation_periode_min@thermostat_o.label: Minimum time between valve updates (min)
auto_regulation_periode_min@thermostat_o.info: The valve gets a new opening at most this often.

underlying_entity_ids@thermostat_over_sw.label: Devices to control
underlying_entity_ids@thermostat_over_sw.hint: Several switches get shifted start times to smooth the power draw.
underlying_entity_ids@thermostat_over_sw.info:
**over_switch**: switch, input_boolean, select or climate entities.
**over_valve**: number entities that set the valve opening.
**over_climate**: climate entities.

With several switches each one still gets its full on-time; VT only shifts their start so fewer run at once (smoother power draw). At high demand they overlap.

tpi_cycle.title: Heating cycle
tpi_cycle.caption: One bar per cycle: on for the computed share, off for the rest. Pulses shorter than the shortest on-time are skipped.

tpi_formula.title: How much to heat
tpi_formula.caption: Two stacked bars for an example: room gap × coef_int + outdoor gap × coef_ext = heating share, capped at 100 %.

tpi_thresholds.title: Stop and resume band
tpi_thresholds.caption: Temperature line above the target: crossing target+stop turns heating off, falling below target+resume turns it back on.

valve_curve.title: Requested vs sent opening
valve_curve.caption: x: opening the algorithm wants, y: opening sent. Flat at the closed position until 'treat as closed', jumps to the minimum, rises, flattens at the maximum.

send_threshold.title: Only meaningful changes are sent
send_threshold.caption: A wanted value wiggling, and the sent value as steps that only move when the change exceeds the threshold and enough time has passed.

window_delay.title: Window timeline
window_delay.caption: Window open bar; short opening below the wait: nothing; long opening: action after the wait, resumes after the closed wait.

window_slope.title: Temperature-drop detection
window_slope.caption: Temperature line with a sudden fall: slope beyond the threshold marks 'open', ends when the slope recovers or the max duration passes.

motion.title: Motion timeline
motion.caption: Motion pulses; a short pass does nothing, staying switches to the motion preset, leaving returns after the empty delay.

safety.title: Sensor loss
safety.caption: Sensor report dots, then a gap longer than the delay: heating switches to the fixed power until a report arrives.

override.title: Manual change
override.caption: Preset target line, a manual bump, back to the preset target after the duration.

failure.title: Heating failure
failure.caption: Heating share at ≥ threshold for longer than the delay while temperature stays flat: alert.

correction.title: Setpoint correction
correction.caption: Room temp below target; the target sent to the device is raised by the correction, capped by strength.

stagger.title: Several heaters in one room
stagger.caption: Each heater on for the same share of the cycle, start times shifted.

thermostat_over_switch.title: Switch a heater on and off
thermostat_over_switch.body: Versatile Thermostat turns the device on for part of each cycle, more when the room is colder.
thermostat_over_switch.examples: Electric radiators, heating cables, relays, smart plugs, pilot-wire modules.

thermostat_over_valve.title: Set how far a valve opens
thermostat_over_valve.body: Versatile Thermostat sends an opening percentage to the valve and adjusts it as the room warms up.
thermostat_over_valve.examples: Radiator valves that expose their opening as a number (e.g. some Zigbee TRVs).

thermostat_over_climate.title: Drive a device with its own thermostat
thermostat_over_climate.body: The device regulates itself; Versatile Thermostat sets its target and corrects it using your room sensor.
thermostat_over_climate.examples: Thermostatic radiator valves, air conditioners, heat pumps.

thermostat_central_config.title: Central configuration
thermostat_central_config.body: Shared defaults (outdoor sensor, presets, window and safety behaviour) that every VTherm can take over.
thermostat_central_config.examples: Create it first if you have several rooms.

window.question: How should this room notice an open window?

presets.from_central: These temperatures come from the central configuration and apply to every thermostat that uses it.
presets.pending: Save first: the thermostat creates its own preset temperatures when it stops using the central ones.

ui.saved: Saved. The thermostat has been reloaded.
ui.not_saved_incomplete: Not saved: some required settings are still empty. They are marked in the index.
ui.not_saved_rejected: Not saved: Versatile Thermostat rejected a setting. It is marked below.
ui.central_nothing: Nothing set there, so Versatile Thermostat's defaults apply.
ui.chooser_no_central: No central configuration yet. With several rooms, create it first: every thermostat can then take over its defaults.
ui.empty: No Versatile Thermostats yet. Use “New” above to create the first one.
ui.discard: Discard the unsaved changes on this thermostat?
